pages.title: Omega-One
pages.text: The first ordinal that cannot be counted, the first uncountable infinity in the order of ordinals. Every countable ordinal comes before it. The token is heavy and solid, and seems to have no edges. It refuses to be listed.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Climbing past epsilon-naught in the Ordinal Recursor, I eventually ran out of countable ordinals. Combining aleph-null and cardinal shards with dark energy, I reached the first uncountable one.
Made in $(item)Ordinal Recursor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Transfinite Hierarchy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes I, Aleph-One, Continuum Shard.
